summary: Your connection's traffic in and out, live, with its last minute drawn
description: The rate coming in leads, what goes out follows, and the last minute is a horizon: in above the line, out below it, on one scale so they compare. Names the link the traffic takes (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, VPN), with the minute's peak and what it moved. Reads the kernel's counters once a second, only while it is on screen.
